digest.overview: Short window heavy on trust and privacy angles: Dario Amodei frames AI backlash as a crisis of trust rather than risk warnings, while ChatGPT's new desktop tracking feature surfaces. Local inference sees concrete gains with Qwen3-8 on GB300 hardware and Koboldcpp adding video gen.

top_story.headline: ChatGPT desktop app now tracks clicks and keystrokes via 'Computer History'
top_story.summary: macOS app builds timelines of user actions for training, automation suggestions, and resuming tasks; feeds into ChatGPT and Codex.
top_story.why_it_matters: Turns everyday desktop activity into persistent training data with no opt-out details yet; direct escalation from prior memory features.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Community notes trust erosion and privacy creep alongside excitement for local perf jumps; Dario's framing resonates but does not shift broader skepticism.

model_releases.headline: Qwen3-8 2.4T hits 288k tokens/s on Nvidia GB300 NVL72
model_releases.summary: 4k tokens/s per GPU across 72 GPUs; configurable reasoning without extra tuning.

model_releases.headline: Koboldcpp v1.119 adds Minimax H3 video generation and I2V
model_releases.summary: Requires specific 4-file setup; single-binary GGUF runner gains multimodal video support.

frontier_labs.headline: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei: AI backlash is fundamentally a crisis of trust
frontier_labs.summary: Pushes back on over-pessimism claims; ordinary people distrust companies, governments, and institutions more than risk warnings.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: Its hard to imagine... that Google AI Overview alone would not profoundly change the nature of the web, and the information we consume and act on as a result.
influencer_takes.context: Highlights structural shift from search to AI summaries already underway.

influencer_takes.author: Simon Willison
influencer_takes.quote: I do agree that the public has a negative view of AI... but I don’t think it is primarily caused by me or any other AI leader warning about AI’s risks. I think it is fundamentally a crisis of trust.
influencer_takes.context: Direct quote amplifying Amodei's point in newsletter context.

research_radar.headline: 1.7B TwIL-LM2 beats Qwen3-8B and Gemma-4-26B on strict-7 formal reasoning via LoRA on SmolLM2
research_radar.summary: Narrow specialist adapter flips script on scale-is-everything for formal logic tasks.

post_ideas.hook: ChatGPT is now literally watching every click and keystroke on your desktop.
post_ideas.draft: ChatGPT's new Computer History feature records your macOS actions to build timelines, suggest automations, and resume half-done tasks. Your workflow just became training data.
post_ideas.why_viral: Privacy tension + concrete product change; readers will test or rage immediately.

post_ideas.hook: Dario Amodei says the AI backlash isn't about doomer warnings—it's a trust crisis.
post_ideas.draft: Amodei: people don't trust companies, governments or institutions. That's the real driver of negative views, not risk talk from leaders.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct quote from frontier CEO reframes narrative; invites agreement or pushback.

post_ideas.hook: Qwen3-8 2.4T running at 288k tokens/s on a single GB300 NVL72 rack.
post_ideas.draft: NVIDIA demo: 4k t/s per GPU × 72 = 288k total. Open weights hitting serious inference scale without cloud.
post_ideas.why_viral: Numbers shock + local/open angle; counters closed-lab dominance narrative.
